test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term 'interact' is the most suitable in this context, as it refers to communicating or being involved directly. In this case, it suggests that attendees of the festival had a chance to engage and communicate with the tribes.
 
• 'Interact' fits semantically with the intended activity and purpose of the festival which facilitates communication and interaction between tribes and attendees.
 
• The term 'interact' fits both grammatically and contextually into the sentence, improving the coherence and overall meaning of the passage.
 
• 'Interact' aligns with the festival's effort to promote an understanding and appreciation of tribal culture by fostering direct contact and communication.

 

*Therefore the correct passage is: A new initiative was organized by Chhattisgarh Tourism Board in form of National Tribal Dance Festival. The event gave an **insight** to the tribal way of life. People from all walks of life had an opportunity to ****interact**** with many tribes. Chhattisgarh is one of the Indian states which have richness and (4) ________ in tribal life. The state is home to many(5) ________ tribes of India. The program happened from 28 October to 30 October, 2021 at the Science College Ground in Raipur.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• 'Hit', 'Strike' and 'Attack' all suggest aggressive actions and do not fit into the context of a cultural festival which is an event characterized by learning, appreciating, and peaceful interactions rather than conflict or violence.
